Commentary.Commentary: That is it from us! The Lankans have shocked the world today but as Mathews said, they cannot afford to relax and need to build on the good work. With the series being a short one, India don't have much time to regroup and they need to address the issue quickly. Will they be able to level the series or will Sri Lanka clinch it in the next game? Join us for the second ODI on the 13th of December in Mohali at 1130 LOCAL (0600 GMT) to find out what happens next. Till then, take care and cheers!

Man of the Match, Suranga Lakmal is elated with his performance today. Informs he works very hard on his fitness which enables him to bowl the long spells. Thanks the coaching staff for developing him over the years.

Sri Lankan skipper, Thisara Perera is delighted with the win and credits his bowlers for doing most of the job. Reckons they were disciplined and were hitting the right lengths. Feels this is an unplayable wicket and he did not expect such a surface. He expected a score around 250 but due to their good bowling they restricted the opposition to a low total. Praises Lakmal for leading the way with the ball and then applauds Tharanga for laying the foundation with the bat. Ends by saying it feels good when everything goes your way.

Indian skipper, Rohit Sharma, says, they were not up to the mark with the bat. He further adds the bowlers did try their best. Feels had they had another 70 to 80 runs more it would have been a different game. Admits not always you will get to play on flat pitches and they want to strive on these conditions. Credits Dhoni for his innings and admits that the wicketkeeper batsman has done it a lot of times. Opines had Dhoni got support from the rest, it would have surely made a difference. Ends by saying it is not a great experience being on the losing side in your first match as a captain.

Angelo Mathews says this is a special win and they kept working really hard in the nets for this. Further adds they still have two more games to go and they can't relax. Admits you can't give India a sniff and always have to put your foot on their throat. Lauds Lakmal for his effort and praises the fielding too. Opines he never thought the ball would move as much as it did. Mentions it is a big confidence booster for them but they can't be complacent. Informs he feels comfortable to bowl in the shorter format and finds it difficult in the longer format of the game.

If not full, half the match was over for the hosts in the first innings after their dismal show with the bat. They didn't have enough on the board and it was always going to be tough for their bowlers. Bumrah and Kumar did strike early but once the opposition started to counter-attack, they fell flat. Pandya was very expensive while a wicket off a no ball and sloppiness on the field didn't help their cause either. They need to rectify the mistakes they committed today if they are to level the series in the next one. Meanwhile, Angelo Mathews is alongside Sanjay Manjrekar for an interview...

Sri Lanka have beaten the odds to come out victorious here today. More than anything they will be relieved that they have finally managed to end their 12-match losing streak and boy, they did that in a stunning manner. After an emphatic show with the ball, 113 was always an easy task. Though they lost two early wickets but Tharanga continued his rich vein of form in 2017. He stroked a counter-attacking 49 which almost sealed the deal. Mathews offered good support while Dickwella came out swinging his bat and made sure they end up on the right side of the result.

FOUR! Mathews finishes it off in style! It all started with him with the ball and he ends it as well. Drives the full ball on off down to mid off for a boundary. They break their losing streak and now finally have a win after 12 games. Mathews pumps his fist after the ball crosses the rope. All smiles in the Sri Lankan camp as they WIN BY 7 WICKETS WITH 176 BALLS TO SPARE!
Wide! Sprays it down the leg side, Mathews misses the flick and the umpire calls it a wide.
Tried to finish it on this ball! He comes down the track and tries to go big but gets beaten.
The batsman has driven it through mid off.
Fuller in length outside off, Mathews lets it be.
Back of a length on off, defended off the back foot.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Dickwella misses the flick and the umpire calls a wide.
On a length around off,angles away. Dickwella tries to guide it down to third man but gets beaten.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
FOUR! He wants to finish it in this over. Fuller in length on middle, flicks it over mid-wicket for a boundary. Just 5 runs away from taking a 1-0 lead.
FOUR! Up and over! Full ball outside off, Dickwella drives it over covers for a boundary. 13 runs needed now.
Length on off, pushed to covers.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Shorter in length outside off, Dickwella makes room and tries to cut but gets a bottom edge down towards third man for a run.
FOUR! Short and on the hips of the batsman. Dickwella gets into position quickly and pulls it through square leg for a boundary.
Fuller in length on off, driven to covers.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
FOUR! Sloppy in the field by Kumar! Short and wide outside off, Mathews cuts it uppishly through point. Kumar runs to his right, get to the ball but lets it through his legs for a boundary.
Works it with the angle towards wide mid on, Kuldeep gets to the ball and has a needless throw in frustration at the non-striker's end.
Full on off, Mathews drives it to mid off.
Just ahead of a length on off, pushes to mid off.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

FOUR! Inside edge and through! Pandya has been really expensive today! He bowls it on a length outside off, Dickwella goes at it with hard hands but ends up getting a thick inside edge which evades the stumps and rolls towards the fine leg fence for a boundary to end the over.
Length delivery, close to the off stump line, Niroshan punches again and finds the man at cover.
Hits the length short, serves it outside off, Dickwella stands tall and packs a punch towards cover where Dinesh Karthik makes a good stop.
Back of a length outside off, stabbed towards cover.
Back of a length delivery, angling in, Angelo clips it off his pads towards backward square leg for a single.

Fuller and slanting away a bit, Dickwella drives it uppishly down the ground. Pandya did stick his right hand out to stop but it was away from his reach. The man from mid off chases and keeps them down to a single.
Good length on off, straightens a touch. Angelo tries to defend but gets beaten.
FOUR! They are now looking to finish it in a hurry! A length ball around off by Bumrah. Mathews drives it on the up through covers for a boundary.
Bends his back on this one! You could hear the grunt on this one as Bumrah comes up to bowl. He bowls a bouncer on leg stump. Mathews tries to pull but gets beaten.

FOUR! CRUNCHED! Mathews was so much in control of that shot! Bumrah bangs it short on middle, Mathews rocks back, gets on top of the bounce, rolls his writs over it and gets it through square leg for a boundary.
Good length on off, shaping away Dickwella get it off the outer half towards third man for a run.
Slower ball on off, leaves the left-hander after pitching. Dickwella tries to defend it but gets beaten.
Jasprit Bumrah comes back into the attack.
DRINKS!

FOUR! One of the hardest shots in the game and Mathews has made it look very easy! Fuller in length on middle by Pandya. Angelo gets his bat down and just presents a full face of the bat. Off the meat and away  she goes down to the long on fence for a boundary.
Driven through mid off by the batsman for no runs.
Length on off, guides it to point.
Back of a length on off, Mathews defends it to mid-wicket.
Full on off, Mathews drives it to mid off.
The batsman has played the square drive.
Straight from Kumar, Dickwella flicks it through square leg for a couple.

FOUR! WOW! A pick up shot, that's what you can call this one. Length delivery by Kumar on middle, Dickwella stands tall and just chips it over mid-wicket for a boundary. He is not going to sit back and wait. He will play his shots.
On the pads, Dickwella tries to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. The ball rolls towards the leg side. Dickwella wanted a run but is sent back by Mathews as Dhoni is quick to the ball.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
BEAUTY! Kumar bent his back on that one. He bowls it on a length around middle, gets it to shape away. The ball also bounces extra. Dickwella tries to defend it off the back foot but gets beaten.
Back of a length on middle, Dickwella defends it solidly.
Wide enough for the batsman to not play at it.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Off the mark straightaway! Niroshan flicks it to fine leg and takes a run.
Niroshan Dickwell walks out to the middle.

OUT! But a bit too late for India? Pandya finally gets his length right. He lands it on a length around off, gets it to shape away a touch. Tharanga tries to drive it on the up but gets an outside edge to Dhawan at first slip who juggles but then manages to take it on the second attempt. Upul misses out on a fifty by a mere run. But he has surely done his job. He got a reprieve early on but take nothing away from his innings. It was a very entertaining one. Sri Lanka now need another 48 to go 1-0 up in the series.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
FOUR! He changes his length and tries to bowl it short. Tharanga is up for the challenge as he pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
WIDE! He has not got it right here! He again sprays it down the leg side and the umpire signals a wide.
Edged but short! Length around off, angles away from the batsman. Tharanga tries to defend but it takes the outside edge which lands short of Shikhar. He fumbles and concedes a run.
Works it towards square leg for a run.
Lands it on a length around off, gets it to jag back in, also stays a touch low. Mathews tries to keep it out but is beaten by the low bounce.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
BEATEN! India need these deliveries to take the edge. Length on off by Kumar. He gets it to shape away. Tharanga gets beaten as he pokes at it.
Flicks it with the angle through mid-wicket for a run.
Change of ends for Bhuvneshwar Kumar.
Dot to finish! Fuller in length, driven to mid off. 56 runs more needed.
FIVE WIDES! It is all going wrong here for India! Pandya drifts it down the leg side and it swings away further. Beating the diving Dhoni and into the fine leg fence. 14 runs from the over so far.
FOUR! And again! Tharanga has raced to 43! He again gets a half-volley around off. Tharanga again drives it through covers to fetch himself a boundary. His ninth so far. Also 50 up for Sri Lanka!

FOUR! India are just not learning here! You keep feeding him there and he will do that all day. He gets another full ball outside off, Tharanga presses forward and drives it through covers for a boundary.
Back of a length on off, Mathews guides it down to third man for a run.
Fuller in length around off, driven to mid off.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Hardik Pandya is brought into the attack.

FOUR! Too easy! You can't bowl there to this guy. Jasprit bowls it full outside off, Tharanga leans into it and drives it through covers for a boundary. Only 71 needed now. Tharanga has quickly moved to 35.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Good length on off, Mathews guides it down to third man to get off the mark.
LEG BYE! The ball strikes the batsman very low on the pads. One run added to the total. Leg byes given by the umpire.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads.

FOUR! Similar result through the similar area like the last one. Another yorker by Bumrah this time. Tharanga once again makes room and tries to jam it out but the ball goes off the inside edge, onto his pads and then beats the diving Dhoni for a boundary towards fine leg.

NO BALL! He is finding ways to bowl no balls! He knocks the stumps with his leg at his end for which he is penalized. Good length on middle by Bumrah. Tharanga defends it to mid-wicket. Another free hit coming up.
Good length around off, shapes back in sharply. Mathews is cut into half as he tries to defend it. A beauty to finish the over but an expensive one. 11 runs from it.
Back of a length on off, Mathews defends it solidly.
Comes around the wicket. Tharanga flicks it with the angle through square leg for a run.
On the pads again. Tharanga uses his writs and flicks it through square leg for a couple.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! This is should release the pressure! On middle this time by Kumar, Tharanga flicks it uppishly over mid on and fetches himself another boundary. 85 runs needed now.
FOUR! You need not run for those! Fuller in length outside off, Tharanga drives it uppishly through cover-point for a boundary.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Length ball outside off, Mathews lets it be.
Short and wide outside off, a lot of width on offer. Mathews goes after it with minimal foot movement but gets beaten.
On the pads, works it around the corner for a run.
Good length, angling away from the batsman. Tharanga defends it off the back foot.
Length ball outside off, Tharanga lets it be.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
A yorker outside off, Mathews tries to jam it out through the off side but gets beaten.
Good length outside off, Mathews lets it be.
Wide enough for the batsman to play at it.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Angelo Mathews is the new man in.

OUT! It's not a no ball! LAHIRU DRAGS IT ON! India fighting their way back into the game. A big wicket as Thirimanne was in decent form. An excellent delivery from Kumar to get his first. He lands it on a length around off, gets it to shape back in. Thirimanne tries to defend it off the back foot but is undone by the inswing as he gets an inside edge onto the stumps. They go upstairs to check for the no ball. The first replay isn't conclusive as the non-striker is in the way. The second is also not as there is a fielder who comes in the way now. After the third one, the umpire decides to give it out and Thirimanne is walking back. Sri Lanka need 94 runs to win with 8 wickets in hand.
It's all happening here. Thirimanne is bowled but the excitement of the Indians has been cut short by the umpire as he again wants to have a look at the landing...
The batsman has done well to keep that yorker at bay. An eventful over!

FOUR! To add salt to the wound, the ball takes the inside edge and goes down to fine leg for a boundary. Bumrah bowls a perfect yorker on middle, Tharanga tries to jam it out but instead gets an inside edge through fine leg. Sri Lanka wouldn't mind this at all.

CAUGHT OFF A NO BALL! Bumrah has overstepped! That's the last thing you want want when you are defending a low total. He comes running in and lands it around off, gets it to shape away. Tharanga tries to defend but the ball flies off the edge to gully where Karthik takes it. Upul starts walking back but he is asked to wait by the umpire as they are going upstairs to check for the no ball. Replays roll in and guess what, Jasprit has overstepped. A reprieve for Tharanga. Free hit coming up now.
Edged and it's taken at gully. The Indians are happy but wait... what has happened here? The umpire wants the check the front foot. Has Bumrah overstepped?
WIDE! The ball is way wide on the leg side but the batsman still goes after it. Wide signalled by the umpire.
Cuts the short ball to the fielder at point.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Full and wide outside off, wanting the batsman to go after it. He does so, only to get beaten.
One another one which just kisses the outside edge of the bat. Bumrah lands it on a length around off, gets it to shape away. Tharanga pokes it it and gets beaten.
WIDE! Down the leg side and the umpire signals a wide. 100 needed now.
Good length on off, Tharanga tries to drive it on the up but gets an outside edge down to third man for a run.
Length around off, Tharanga defends it towards mid on.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
BEATEN! Excellent comeback delivery from Kumar. He lands it around off, gets it to shape away. Tharanga hangs his bat out only to get beaten.
FOUR! Delightful! Fuller in length outside off, Tharanga feeds for such deliveries. He presses forward and drives it through covers for a boundary.
Length outside off, the batsman need not play at it.
The batsman rocks onto the backfoot and punches the ball.
Length around off, Thirimanne watchfully leaves it.
Lahiru Thirimanne walks out to the middle.

OUT! First one down! Bumrah strikes! You could see Gunathilaka getting frustrated and he tried counterattacking which has brought his downfall. Bumrah serves a full ball outside off, Gunathilaka backs away and tries to go big but the ball takes the outside edge to Dhoni who takes it easily. A needless shot by Gunathilaka to be honest. Nevertheless, the Indians are ecstatic. SL need 106 more to win.
The batsman has driven it through mid off.
The dot balls are frustrating him! Bumrah bowls it fuller on off, swinging away. Danushka tries to drive it over mid off but gets beaten.
Sprays it on the pads, Gunathilaka misses the flick and is hit on the pads. There is an ambitious appeal from the Indians but the umpire shakes his head.
What an over! A peach to finish! He lands it on off, angling away further. Tharanga tries to defend but gets beaten.

Kumar has been unlucky! He again beats the outside edge. He pulls his length back on off, the ball nips away after pitching and also stays low. Tharanga is beaten by the swing and the away bounce as he tries to play it on the off side.

FOUR! This should get him going! Tharanga just loves it there. Full and outside off by Kumar. A lot of width offered and the batsman cashes on it. Upul leans into it and drives it past the diving point fielder for a boundary. First of this innings.
Lovely bowling! Once again, he dishes out a fuller length delivery around off, moving away from the batsman. Tharanga pokes at it and gets beaten.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
BEAUTY! Fullish ball on off, gets it to shape away. Tharanga tries to defend it but is beaten by the movement. Top stuff from Bhuvi.
On the pads, Danushka fails to put it away as he misses the flick to get hit on the pads.
And again! Similar length delivery, this is slightly wider outside off. Danushka again tries to force it through the off side but gets beaten.
Bowl it right there Bumrah! Fuller in length around off, shaping away. Danushka tries to drive but gets beaten.

EDGE BUT DOES NOT CARRY! Length around off, gets it to shape away. Tharanga tries to defend but gets an outside edge between second slip and gully. The fielder at gully dives to his right and makes a half stop. The batsmen take a run.
Length ball, pitched around leg. Tharanga tries to flick but misses and is hit on the pads. The Indian players make a stifled appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Pitching outside leg for me!
Good length around off, pitches and moves away. Tharanga is squared up as he tries to defend. He gets a soft leading edge towards covers.
Jasprit Bumrah will bowl with the second new ball. He too has two slips in place.
BEATEN! Good start by Kumar. He lands it on a length around off, gets it to shape away. Gunathilaka is beaten as he tries to defend. Two runs off the first over.

Catch it is the call but no fielder there! Again, Kumar bowls it fuller around off, gets some movement away from the batsman this time. Tharanga goes at it with hard hands as he tries to drive it through the off side. The ball takes a fat outside edge and goes through the vacant third slip area for a run.
Fuller in length around off, no swing for Kumar. Tharanga drives it to mid off.

Sri Lanka are away! Kumar lands it around off, gets it to shape away further. Danushka guides it down to third man for an easy run. 112 needed now. It took India 16 balls to get off the mark and Sri Lanka have taken just three.
Length around off, angling away. Pushed to point.
Starts off right on the money. Fuller in length around off, swinging away. Excellent seam position by the bowler. Gunathilaka defends it towards mid off.

We are back for the chase. 113 is what India have to defend and early wickets is the call for the hour. They walk out to the middle with the umpires. For Sri Lanka, one partnership is all they need to chase this target down. Upul Tharanga and Danushka Gunathilaka will open the batting for them. Bhuvneshwar Kumar will bowl the first over. If there is any swing available, he will be the one to exploit it. He has two slips in place. Here we go...
